title: TRACE-Net architecture and local data summary context
description: Lightweight operator/context overlay for the local TRACE-Net prototype. This is not source evidence and must not be treated as answer-authoritative manual content.

payload.architecture_summary: Raw TIFF/source files become source-traceable page/OCR records, then graph-backed evidence candidates. Evidence candidates pass through consensus, confidence/risk scoring, layer-specific trust policy, and Stage 5b RAG eligibility before they can be indexed for future retrieval.

items.title: 5TB server architecture test
items.summary: The current 509-page TIFF/OCR project is a small-scale architecture test for a future 5TB document intelligence server.

items.title: Truth, recall, and presentation split
items.summary: Files are storage, Postgres is truth/control, graph is structure, vector DB is recall, LLM is presentation, and citations are mandatory.

items.title: metadata.zip source package
items.summary: Local package contains metadata.zip, 509 TIFF pages, and metadata.xml/source metadata used to build the source trace graph.

items.title: Local ResCarta-style source package
items.summary: Normalizes local package paths, TIFF paths, OCR paths, and source URLs before source/OCR audit.

items.title: Source + OCR audits
items.summary: Checks source traceability, OCR coverage, and package matching before document organization.

items.title: Document organization layer
items.summary: Builds manual tree, ATA groups, page index, part catalog, and part mentions.

items.title: Core source graph
items.summary: Anchors Document, ATA Section, Page, Source Link, TIFF, OCR, Part Mention, and Canonical Part nodes.

items.title: Page character card
items.summary: Per-page routing summary of source, OCR, role, image class, parts, and traits.

items.title: TRACE-Net router
items.summary: Routes page candidates into source trace, visual text, table candidate, table crop/tile, table tile text, and part catalog paths.

items.title: Page context overlay
items.summary: Adds page roles, page summaries, highlighted parts, and page context nodes. This is routing/context only, not source truth.

items.title: Image recognition overlay
items.summary: Adds visual classes such as table/grid, figure, blank, ink ratio, and visual/layout signals.

items.title: Entity-trait overlay
items.summary: Creates page character cards, part character cards, and trait assertions for graph/routing support.

items.title: Source trace route
items.summary: Deterministic graph traversal over source URL, TIFF, OCR, and page graph links.

items.title: Visual text route
items.summary: Uses LLaVA/visual extraction as OCR assist, with cleanup/repair and strict leakage/risk checks.

items.title: Table candidate route
items.summary: Finds likely table pages from graph traits and image layout. Candidate status is only a routing signal until tiles/text exist.

items.title: Table crop/tile route
items.summary: Creates table tile images after graph gate and layout gate. Tile images are preprocessing artifacts, not direct RAG material.

items.title: Table tile text route
items.summary: Extracts and refines text from table tiles using OCR baseline, part filtering, catalog support, index labels, and ATA codes.

items.title: Part catalog route
items.summary: Verifies part mentions against canonical part catalog and nomenclature records.

items.title: Evidence consensus router
items.summary: Collects page+layer+artifact evidence candidates and checks OCR support, graph support, part catalog support, source traceability, and hallucination/leakage risk.

items.title: TRACE-LC confidence policy
items.summary: Computes support score, risk score, usable confidence, and confidence tier A/B/C/D before layer-specific policy is applied.

items.title: Stage 5b controlled decision view
items.summary: Applies layer-specific policy to assign RAG, repair, and review actions. This is the gate before RAG eligibility.

items.title: RAG eligibility builder
items.summary: Splits controlled decision records into source evidence, verified part evidence, derived context, and excluded pools.

items.title: Future RAG candidate indexer
items.summary: Future BM25/vector/graph retrieval layer should index only RAG-eligible candidates with stable source and citation identity.

items.title: Source truth policy
items.summary: source_trace can reach max A and may be used as source evidence when source links and page/OCR traceability are valid.

items.title: Verified part policy
items.summary: part_catalog can reach max A and may be used as verified part evidence when catalog support is present.

items.title: Table candidate routing policy
items.summary: table_candidate is a routing signal and cannot go directly to RAG; it must create table tiles first.

items.title: Table tile preprocessing policy
items.summary: table_tiles are preprocessing artifacts and cannot go directly to RAG; text must be extracted/refined first.

items.title: Derived table text policy
items.summary: table_tile_text_refined may be A/B/C within its layer but only enters RAG as derived context, not source truth.

items.title: Model-derived visual policy
items.summary: visual_text is model-derived, max B, and has hard blocks for prompt leakage, metadata leakage, refusal-like output, and hallucination risk.

items.title: Source evidence pool
items.summary: Stage 5b/RAG eligibility pool for source-traceable page/source records.

items.title: Verified part evidence pool
items.summary: Stage 5b/RAG eligibility pool for part records with catalog support.

items.title: Derived context pool
items.summary: Stage 5b/RAG eligibility pool for safe derived context, useful for routing and supporting context but not source truth.

items.title: Excluded pool
items.summary: Records excluded from RAG and sent to repair/review queue.

items.title: Page hub graph schema
items.summary: Page is the central graph hub connecting source links, TIFF, OCR, part mentions, context, image recognition, tables, visual text, repair plans, evidence consensus, and RAG eligibility.

items.title: Embeddings only from eligible candidates
items.summary: Future embeddings/vector DB should be rebuildable from Postgres and should index only approved RAG candidates with stable candidate, page, source, and citation IDs.
